title: Ling-3.2-flash's 3D workflow includes material checks for roughness, normal maps and bump detail
author: jkris050
selftext:
The Ling-3.2-flash release includes a material-development detail alongside its reference-to-3D examples: Ant Ling describes the model inspecting headless renders of material spheres, comparing roughness, normal maps and bump detail, and then refining the scripts.

For an asset prototype, matching the intended shape and matching its surface appearance are separate jobs. This announced workflow addresses the surface side with specific material properties and a rendered view of their effect. The changes feed into another script iteration as the appearance is refined.
